name: singlet_ambient_profile_estimation
title: Estimate per-channel ambient RNA profile
description: Estimates the gene composition of cell-free RNA in each channel of an unfiltered droplet matrix and writes one profile per sample to varm/ambient_profile_<sample>. The default soupx method pools low-UMI droplets on CPU without clusters; cellbender, scar and decontx are model-based or hybrid alternatives that may be slower. Use it on a matrix that still contains empty droplets, before count removal with singlet_ambient_count_removal. Do not use it on filtered matrices, on pooled channels, or to remove counts.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: .singlet path or URI (s3://, r2://, https://) or workspace handle. Needs raw/counts.

method.description: soupx (default: pooled low-UMI droplets, CPU, no clusters); cellbender (learned profile, GPU advised); scar (iterative cell-free estimate); decontx (profiles pooled from other clusters).

sample_key.description: obs column that defines channels; one profile is written per distinct value.

seed.description: Random seed for cellbender and decontx; ignored by soupx and scar.

device.description: Execution device; auto uses CUDA for cellbender when enough memory is free, otherwise CPU. soupx is CPU only.

dry_run.description: Return estimated seconds, peak memory and device without running or writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing ambient profile members for this method instead of failing.

soupx.description: Options used only when method is soupx.

umi_low.description: Lower exclusive bound of total UMIs for pooled droplets (SoupX soupRange).

umi_high.description: Upper exclusive bound of total UMIs for pooled droplets (SoupX soupRange).

cell_mask_key.description: obs column of cell calls; called droplets are left out of the pool when present.

scar.description: Options used only when method is scar.

prob.description: Cell-free threshold probability for the multinomial rule; higher values give fewer cell-free droplets.

iterations.description: Rounds of re-estimating the profile from cell-free droplets.

min_raw_counts.description: Droplets with fewer total UMIs are dropped before the cell-free test.

cellbender.description: Options used only when method is cellbender.

epochs.description: Training epochs for the variational model; upstream default is 150.

low_umi_cutoff.description: Droplets with total UMIs at or below this are excluded from the analysis.

total_droplets.description: Droplets analysed by the model; upstream default is 25000.

expected_cells.description: Expected cell count; null uses the model default. Sets the ambient filter via max(expected_cells, 5000).

min_ambient_counts_in_cells.description: Genes whose projected ambient counts in cells are at or below this are returned unchanged.

decontx.description: Options used only when method is decontx.

cluster_key.description: obs column of cluster labels; when null, clusters are found internally as in DecontX.

delta.description: Initial Beta concentrations for the native share; refitted each iteration by default.

var_genes.description: Variable genes for internal clustering when cluster_key is null.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: profile written; dry_run: estimate only; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. varm/ambient_profile_<sample>. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs, keys: method, samples (droplets used, UMI window or rounds, cell-free count), genes_excluded, convergence. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
